_comment: Tube emboss code format config, keyed by field_type (add one entry per SKU if formats diverge later). 'blocks' is an ordered list of fixed-width chunks: type 'int_range' checks the chunk is all digits AND numerically within [min,max] (e.g. day 1-31, not just 'first digit is 0-3' - that wrongly let '39' or '00' through); type 'charset' checks each character in the chunk against a regex class. expected_length is the sum of block widths. No auto-strip/auto-fix is ever applied to OCR text - a length mismatch or any block failing its check always flags FORMAT_MISMATCH, regardless of confidence.

tube_emboss_default.label: Tube Emboss Code (DDMMYY + 3-char alphanumeric batch + 1-digit manufacture code)
tube_emboss_default.description: DDMMYY date (day 01-31, month 01-12, year 00-99) + 3-char batch code (from PPIC batch number table, confirmed can mix letters and digits e.g. AL1/AL2, not letters-only) + 1-digit Cosmax manufacture code, e.g. 310826ALZ8 -> day=31 month=08 year=26 batch=ALZ mfg=8
